reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "bottlerocket settings taint format (#6489) #6489 (Jason Deal)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: Taints are written into Bottlerocket node settings in the corrected format, so Bottlerocket nodes carrying taints receive differently-formatted (fixed) taint settings after the upgrade.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, verify that taints on Bottlerocket nodes are rendered and applied as expected.

proposed.statement: Karpenter-provider-aws v1.0.0 fixes the format of taints written into Bottlerocket node settings (bug fix 'bottlerocket settings taint format', #6489), changing how taints are rendered in Bottlerocket settings.
